mechanism: failed step attempts are instant transport rejections (0 tokens, 0 latency, nothing billable); on 110 runs the ledger run-total omits tokens of COMPLETED earlier steps, so recorded cost understates true cost
auditor_note: auditor's 234 = runs with any failed-step entry; paper's 110 = runs whose total is actually understated. Both traceable; 110 is the cost-relevant count.
